note: The one node with more than 64 outlets is node n in XPSWMM/CTIA_EXI.inp: 65 conduits from n to n, an XPSWMM conversion artefact. The model routes DYNWAVE, which the extension never touches; switched to KINWAVE it stops with ERROR 131 (extension off) or ERROR 115 (on) before routing. v1.0 and v1.1 write identical .out files for it in modes 00, 11, 21 and 31 (KINWAVE) and 11 (as written). Every other corpus node has 64 outlets or fewer, where v1.0 and v1.1 execute the same code, so no corpus result changes.
